insights.one_liner: L'Oréal is the French beauty group behind brands like Lancôme, Garnier and La Roche-Posay, and an IND visa sponsor with an office in Hoofddorp.

culture.text: Around 96,000 people on LinkedIn across 150 countries, working in 37 brands split into Luxe, Consumer Products, Dermatological Beauty and Professional Products.
Many staff come from French business schools like ESCP, ESSEC and NEOMA, mostly in marketing, business and economics.
Says it hires from intern to senior level; the one open role here is a sales director job in Hoofddorp.

open.text: Recognised IND visa sponsor through L'Oreal Nederland B.V.
Its one open job here does not require Dutch.
A Moroccan-born woman rose from intern to boss and doubled L'Oréal revenue in her unit.

growth.text: Revenue was €41.18 billion in 2023, with net profit of €6.18 billion.
Launched skincare brand Dr.G in the US through TikTok Shop.

worth_knowing.text: Has hired advisers to explore offloading US legal liabilities linked to talc and chemicals.
Is rethinking its marketing as AI changes how consumers shop, and says AI cut customer service time by 64%.
